summary: Form checkbox with a slotted label, optional supporting text and an indeterminate state; use for independent on/off choices.

usage.text: The indeterminate attribute is a display and ARIA state only. A user toggle clears it, it does not change what the form receives, and form reset restores it.
The required attribute is satisfied only while checked.

a11y.text: The slotted label names the input through a native label association; an aria-label on the host overrides it. Text in the supporting slot describes the input.

An aria-describedby on the host is resolved against ids in the host's own root and applied to the inner input together with the active error message or supporting text, in browsers with ARIA element reflection.
